comparator.name: Nutrition and Health
comparator.sourceNotes: The current official handbook defines 180 EC: 121 EC of positive-credit compulsory common study (plus two zero-credit safety requirements), a 3-EC restricted mathematics/statistics choice, a 12-EC bachelor thesis and 44 EC of open electives. A zero-minimum skills option does not add credit to the selected pathway, and the optional 6-EC lab-based thesis extension is not selected. Mathematics Applied: Introduction is selected by the official-order tie-break.

notes.text: WUR provides a dedicated nutrition curriculum from macronutrients, digestion and metabolism through food technology, sensory science, dietary-intake measurement, nutritional epidemiology, two nutrition-specific research-methods courses and a nutrition thesis. UCR can combine substantial biomedical science, physiology, psychology, epidemiology, public health, data and communication, but does not reproduce that specialist nutrition sequence course for course.
